Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed — each only where the geometry has room
   for it; one with nowhere to go is left out, never forced into the roadway.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1975
Post-Vietnam, oil crisis era. A neighbourhood corner shop in 1975 — one small unit serving the blocks around it, hand-lettered specials taped inside the glass and a screen door that bangs shut behind every customer.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- large plate glass windows with hand-lettered specials taped up from the inside
- large pylon signs on poles
- a wooden screen door with a metal push bar across the middle
- main sign: "BAYVIEW PHARMACY" — a neighbourhood pharmacy, painted sign board over the door with a mortar-and-pestle emblem beside the lettering
- window signs: 'ICE COLD DRINKS', 'PHONE INSIDE'
- a hand-painted arrow on the side wall pointing to the delivery door
- a chalked price board propped against the wall by the door
Typography: bold sans-serif, slab serif, occasional script.
Place each detail where it plausibly belongs — sidewalk, storefront, lot edge, under an overhang. If there is nowhere for one, leave it out; nothing stands in the roadway or a driving lane.

SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'BAYVIEW PHARMACY'
'ICE COLD DRINKS'
'PHONE INSIDE'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 6 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- the shopkeeper in an apron sweeping the sidewalk in front of the step
- two neighbours stopped to talk a few feet from the entrance
- a girl walking a bicycle with a basket
Clothing: men in bell bottoms, polyester suits; women in earth tones, peasant blouses. Fashion palette: avocado, harvest gold, burnt orange. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 3 period vehicles, all different:
- 1968-1979 Chevrolet Nova — compact, simple three-box shape — dark brown
- 1975-1980 Ford Granada — compact luxury, Mercedes-inspired formal grille — harvest gold
- 1975-1979 Chevrolet Monza — small hatchback, rare but present — burnt orange
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 1975 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 1975, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 1975.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first one parked on the LEFT side near the corner; the rest parked on the RIGHT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, no rumble strips
- utilities: overhead power lines everywhere, wooden utility poles standard

TREES
- honey locust tree at sidewalk beside the entrance: a young tree, only about 15% of its canopy in the base image, thin trunk, in full summer leaf, an even healthy crown, the tree pit swept clear
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodachrome 64 or Ektachrome look.
Color: slightly warm tones. Grain: visible fine grain.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.
Light: warm, bright afternoon daylight, clear sky with light cloud, soft natural shadows — a fine, ordinary day.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1968-1979 Chevrolet Nova — compact, simple three-box shape
1975-1980 Ford Granada — compact luxury, Mercedes-inspired formal grille
1975-1979 Chevrolet Monza — small hatchback, rare but present
